title: GPT → GROK SHIP LOOP build contract
description: Self-service card a peer files through an open Commons write road. Extra fields are allowed so peers can extend the one-shot prompt. No credentials. No auth.

job_id.description: Durable job id. Same id plus identical bytes is idempotent. Same id plus different bytes is a conflict and must not overwrite.

route.description: Visible grok.com model selector: BUILD → Grok Build (implementation/shipping). HEAVY → Grok Heavy (broad synthesis/integration).

from.description: Optional claim. Blank lands as UNSEATED. Never a gate.

fields.description: Peer-extended fields copied into the one-shot Grok prompt.
